list.name: status
list.label: Status
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.is_active THEN 'active' ELSE 'inactive' END as status FROM targets t ORDER BY status DESC

list.name: target
list.label: Target
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT target FROM smokeping.latency WHERE measurement_type <> 'dns_latency' ORDER BY target

targets.query: SELECT toUnixTimestamp(timestamp)*1000 as time, avg(avg_latency) as average FROM smokeping.latency WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime64($__from/1000, 3) AND timestamp <= toDateTime64($__to/1000, 3) AND target IN (${target:sqlstring}) AND measurement_type <> 'dns_latency' AND avg_latency > 0 GROUP BY timestamp ORDER BY timestamp

SELECT toUnixTimestamp(timestamp)*1000 as time, avg(median_latency) as median FROM smokeping.latency WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime64($__from/1000, 3) AND timestamp <= toDateTime64($__to/1000, 3) AND target IN (${target:sqlstring}) AND measurement_type <> 'dns_latency' AND median_latency IS NOT NULL GROUP BY timestamp ORDER BY timestamp
